recommendation.summary: dsh-context@0.59.1 is a DeepSeek Harness web-client plugin (dsh.client.platform=web) providing a Context Dashboard, Context tab, /context command, and preferences card. Author install path is `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-context` followed by `dsh web`, so the evidenced execution profile is web only; no headless, SDK, ACP, or interactive TUI workflow is documented. Node: engines.node is ^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0 (declared support for 22 and 24); CI (pr-checks.yml and release.yml) configures node-version '24', so 24 is the strongest evidenced major and is selected as preferred, with 22 retained as the declared floor. Author DSH baselines: 0.1.5-rc.1 and 0.1.7-rc.2, both declared compatible in dsh.compatibility.dshReleases and verified in docs/compatibility.md; the Radar target 0.2.0-rc.1 is outside that matrix.
